Other Hazards - Sulfur Leak - Lake Erie - Dunnville
Natural gas leak reported at 42 49.715N 079 32.015W.
Mariners are requested to stay clear of the area as toxic and flammable gas may be present.
                                                    Cancels NW-C-2480-26
